description: Illustrative artist export contract. The experiment generates these pixels in memory; production import is not implemented.

sprite.pivotConvention: top-left origin, X right, Y down; feet are the entity origin
sprite.directionConvention: 0 = viewer in front of model +Z; increase toward model +X; relative to actor heading
sprite.socketConvention: Production sockets must supply one normalized 2D position and behind/front ordering for every pitch, direction and frame; none are authored in this combined-outfit proxy.

equipment.attachmentPolicy: Do not infer public equipment from private inventory.

bounds.collision: server-only; visual bounds never replace entity radius/height
